page.overview:
Who is Vorg?

Vorg is a minor character in Invincible, debuting from Season 2 and onwards. He is Allen's Unopan feline pet.

At some point, Allen adopted the Unopan feline and named it Vorg.

Not much has been provided so far in reference to Vorg's history other than he gets up to "All manner of household adventures."
